svg.title: Professor Pac-Man question EPROM map
svg.desc: The 640 KB question EPROM board, its forty logical banks, fourteen populated PPQ ROMs, port F3 selectors, CPU read window, and internal executable question-module organization.

g.text: Bit 7 enables the question board. The remaining selector value chooses one of forty 16 KB banks.
Fourteen sockets are populated. The remaining twenty-six read as $FF and are exercised by self-test.
Each cell shows logical bank, $F3 selector, and MAME EPROM-region offset.
8 × 16 KB · companion program window would select PPS7/PPS8
Populated: 224 KB of 640 KB · banks 0-13 · selectors $80-$8D
Each physical EPROM is an executable presentation module, not a flat question record.
address of the eight-entry tier directory
Repeat control: the fixed program rejects any returned action-list identity found in its
sixteen-entry circular history, then retries selection without changing the bank format.
Bank window: all PPQ addresses are CPU addresses in the active $4000-$7FFF read window.
Production use: normal question selection uses $80-$8D and retains PPS3/PPS4 as support code.
